```{r funcs}
get_network_interaction <- function(map_ids, stringId, species_id = "9606") {
  # Extrai e formata os IDs de interesse
  identifiers <- map_ids %>% 
    pull({{stringId}}) %>% 
    na.omit() %>% 
    paste0(collapse = "%0d")
  
  # Envia a requisição para a API do STRING
  response <- POST(
    url = "https://string-db.org/api/tsv/interaction_partners?identifiers=",
    body = list(
      identifiers = identifiers,
      required_score = "0",
      species = species_id
    ),
    encode = "form",
    config = httr::config(ssl_verifypeer = FALSE)
  )
  
  # Converte o conteúdo da resposta em tabela
  int_network <- read.table(text = content(response, as = "text"), 
                            sep = "\t", 
                            header = TRUE)
  
  # Remove duplicatas
  int_network <- unique(int_network)
  
  return(int_network)
}

combine_scores <- function(dat, evidences = "all", confLevel = 0.4) {
  if(evidences[1] == "all"){
    edat<-dat[,-c(1,2,ncol(dat))]
  } else {
    if(!all(evidences%in%colnames(dat))){
      stop("NOTE: one or more 'evidences' not listed in 'dat' colnames!")
    }
    edat<-dat[,evidences]
  }
  if (any(edat > 1)) {
    edat <- edat/1000
  }
  edat<-1-edat
  sc<- apply(X = edat, MARGIN = 1, FUN = function(x) 1-prod(x))
  dat <- cbind(dat[,c(1,2)],combined_score = sc)
  idx <- dat$combined_score >= confLevel
  dat <-dat[idx,]
  return(dat)
}
```

```{r data}
nodelist <- vroom::vroom("../results/orthology_data/nodelist.csv ")
metamonada_nodelist <- subset(nodelist, nodelist$clade_name == "Metamonada")
```

```{r metamonada_network}
a <- get_network_interaction(metamonada_nodelist, node)

# Recomputing scores
string_edgelist <- combine_scores(a, 
                                  evidences = c("ascore", "escore", "dscore"), 
                                  confLevel = 0.7)

colnames(string_edgelist) <- c("stringId_A", "stringId_B", "combined_score")

# Remove o species id
string_edgelist$stringId_A <- substring(string_edgelist$stringId_A, 6, 1000)
string_edgelist$stringId_B <- substring(string_edgelist$stringId_B, 6, 1000)

setdiff(
  string_edgelist %$% c(stringId_A, stringId_B),
  map_ids %>% pull(stringId)
) 
```
